item.title: The Straddie Hotel Has Reopened and It’s Everything a Queensland Summer Should Be
item.description: The Straddie Hotel is back. North Stradbroke Island's Point Lookout iconic pub has reopened with ocean views, fresh seafood and laidback beach vibes. The post The Straddie Hotel Has Reopened and It’s Everything a Queensland Summer Should Be appeared first on Gold Coast Magazine.

item.title: Milla Coco Brown and Lucas Hickson Claim Victory at 2026 Kim Burton Pro Junior

item.title: Major Facelift Proposed for Iconic Burleigh Headland
item.description: Gold Coast City Council proposes major upgrades for Burleigh Heads, including seawall repairs, possible swimming lagoon and parking relocation. Community feedback is open now. The post Major Facelift Proposed for Iconic Burleigh Headland appeared first on Gold Coast Magazine.

item.title: Where to Watch Super Bowl LX on the Gold Coast
item.description: Discover the best Gold Coast venues for Super Bowl LX on Monday 9 February 2026. Find packages, big screens and American menus at these top pubs and bars. The post Where to Watch Super Bowl LX on the Gold Coast appeared first on Gold Coast Magazine.

item.title: Craig Lowndes Passes the Torch to Will Brown to Race #888 in 2026
